findings.title: Atomic budget accounting
Withdrawal limit is per call only: unlimited withdrawal requests, each up to withdrawal_max_amount
Per-call amount limits only: no cumulative, daily or rate budget on deposit payouts
Withdrawal completion keyed only on memo: any dust payment with the memo marks the withdrawal completed
interactive_deposit and interactive_withdraw skip the deposit_enabled and withdrawal_enabled checks
Unauthenticated confirm_transaction releases anchor-funded deposit payouts without any external deposit
Re-confirming a completed deposit resets status to pending_anchor and pays again
check_trustlines returns from the whole task on one malformed account, stalling every other pending deposit
Each withdrawal starts an unbounded blocking Horizon SSE stream, with cursor "now" and no timeout
confirm_transaction accepts withdrawal transactions and marks them completed via a self-payment
CORS allows every origin to read transaction data from the browser
Serializer emits per-user addresses, deposit/withdraw memos and external data to unauthenticated callers
Unauthenticated /transactions and /transaction expose other users' history and every pending withdraw_memo
Payments are capped per call, with no total or rate limit
